about_short_description.short_description: CPower is an energy management company.

product.name: EnerWise Site Optimization
product.description: AI-driven technology that helps DER owners and developers manage and monetize their assets across multiple energy markets and utility programs by acting on market insights.

product.name: Demand Response
product.description: Service that pays energy users to reduce their power consumption during peak demand periods to help balance the grid.

product.name: Virtual Power Plants
product.description: Aggregation of distributed energy resources that provides grid services as a single entity, enhancing grid flexibility and reliability.

product.name: Distributed Generation
product.description: Service to maximize resilience and shorten the payback period of solar, wind, and other generation assets.

product.name: Energy Storage
product.description: Service to turn on-site capacity into revenue by storing energy for later use.

product.name: Energy Efficiency
product.description: Service to monetize permanently reduced demand by improving energy efficiency.
